note: Allow-listed gameplay tunables from the shipped config of this build. Absent = not a tunable in this build.
more_vs_increased: increased/reduced mods of one stat ADD into one sum; each more/less mod MULTIPLIES separately (see formulas.md)

r87.SPARKS.bCompress.means: Spark: the sparks of one cast are compressed into bodies (PerBody sparks each)

r87.SPARKS.DurAdd.means: Spark: seconds added to the Spark duration

r87.SPARKS.bCastSpeedInterval.means: Spark: cast speed quickens strikes: interval = base interval / (cast speed multiplier ^ CastSpeedExp)

r87.SPARKS.CastSpeedExp.means: Spark: the exponent above (0.5 = square root of the cast speed multiplier)

r87.SPARKS.EchoBodies.means: Spark: Spell Echo adds this many bodies to the cap

r87.SPARKS.DamageMult.means: Spark: damage multiplier per strike of a compressed body

r96.META.fSparkHost70.means: Spark: a monster hit by Sparks of K different Spark skills takes each strike x(1 + (K-1) x f) / K

r91.METAALL.fTrapEffKnee91.means: traps/totems: 0 = no knee; each listed Attack pays the straight price in game_data/trap_prices.json
